values.note: 19 sites with parking spurs at least 30 ft (FS); rec.gov catalogs 18 (002-019), paved, lengths 20-70 ft, four pull-throughs. rec.gov: 'RV or trailers over 36 feet ... will have a very tough time making it through the campground because of tight corners and trees.' Rigs must fit the spur, off the grass.

sites.source: FS page ('Meadow Ridge Campground has 19 campsites with parking areas at least 30 feet long') + rec.gov notice ('RV or trailers over 36 feet over this size will have a very tough time making it through the campground because of tight corners and trees'; 'All vehicles including campers must fit in parking spur (not on grass)') + rec.gov catalog (18 sites, Driveway Entry 14 Back-In / 4 Pull-Through, all Paved, Max Vehicle Length 20-70), read 2026-10-27

hookups.source: FS page ('This is a standard, nonelectric campground') + rec.gov notice ('No hookups available'), read 2026-10-27

values.note: Two vault toilets; drinking water at hydrants, but Colorado rules bar attaching hoses to fill RV tanks. Water and trash reduced before Memorial Day and after Labor Day. Firewood sold by the host.

facilities.source: FS page ('two vault toilets and trash collection'; 'Potable water is available at this site'; 'Pre-season and extended season have reduced service for amenities such as water and trash') + rec.gov notice ('Colorado State regulations prohibit attaching hoses to hydrants to fill RV's'), read 2026-10-27

values.note: FS: open mid-May to mid-September, weather permitting. Dates are 2026's, when rec.gov sells first-come sites either side of the reservation season.

season.source: FS page ('Campground is open from mid-May to mid-September, depending on weather conditions'; 'Seasons of Use Mid-May to mid-September') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/231871/rates (2026 First-come, First-served Seasons 05-08 to 05-21 and 09-07 to 09-19), read 2026-10-27

values.note: Reserve at least four days ahead (877-444-6777 or recreation.gov), up to six months out; reservations recommended Memorial Day - Labor Day, and the shoulder weeks are first-come. Two nights on weekends, three on holiday weekends. First-come sites must be occupied the same night; self-service fee tube. 14 nights in a rolling 60 days.

booking.source: FS page ('Call 877-444-6777 or visit recreation.gov at least four days in advance. Limited site reservations can be made six months prior to arrival'; 'Reservations are recommended between Memorial Day and Labor Day'; 'First-come, first-served sites must be occupied the same night') + rec.gov rules (reservationCutOff 4 'Not Available', minWeekendStay 2, minHolidayWeekendStay 3, maxConsecutiveStay 14, maxStay 14 'Rolling 60 Days') + rates (2026 Peak Season 05-22 to 09-06), read 2026-10-27

values.note: $28 a site; two vehicles or one RV and tow vehicle included, $11 a night for a third vehicle.

fees.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/231871/rates (2026 Peak and First-come seasons: STANDARD NONELECTRIC 28) + FS page ('$28 fee per site for overnight camping ... $11 for a third vehicle'), read 2026-10-27

discounts.source: FS page ('The Interagency Senior Pass and the Interagency Access Pass qualify for a 50% discount at concessionaire-run campsites'), read 2026-10-27

note: Pikes Peak Ranger District campground (Pike-San Isabel NF) on a ridge above Rampart Reservoir, about 10 mi from Woodland Park via Rampart Range Road, 9,200 ft. At most sites steps lead down to the table and fire ring. --Claude
